item.description: Southwark residents are facing a 4.99 per cent increase to their council tax this year, meaning Band D households would pay almost £2,000 in total. item.title: Residents warn of harm as petition grows against 24-Hour gambling in Crystal Palace
item.description: A plan to remove restrictions on a casino’s hours so it could potentially open 24 hours a day would harm vulnerable people and increase antisocial behaviour, according to a petition against it. Around 600 residents have signed the petition urging Croydon Council to reject the proposal for Admiral Gaming Centre on Westow Hill, Crystal Palace.
